what.title: What is colorectal cancer? Global numbers, early-onset rise, survival
what.description: Colorectal cancer explained with cited numbers: 2 million cases a year, where in the bowel it starts, the rise under 50 by birth cohort and survival by stage.

colon.title: The colon and its lining: crypts, stem cells and the APC switch
colon.description: Animated tour of the large bowel and its wall, then one crypt: Lgr5 stem cells renewing the lining every 4–5 days, and what happens when APC is lost.

sequence.title: Polyp to cancer: adenoma–carcinoma sequence, serrated path, CIN, MSI
sequence.description: Scrub 20 years of a polyp becoming cancer: APC, KRAS, SMAD4 and TP53 by stage, the serrated BRAF route, MSI vs CIN, progression risk and CMS subtypes.

risk.title: Colorectal cancer risk factors, prevention and family history risk
risk.description: Family history, colitis, meat, alcohol, smoking, weight, activity and aspirin, each with its published relative risk, plus a family-history risk calculator.

genes.title: Lynch syndrome and FAP: pedigree, mismatch repair and risk by gene
genes.description: Inherited colorectal cancer animated: a three-generation pedigree, how mismatch repair fails, PLSD cancer risk by gene, testing criteria and surveillance.

screening.title: Colorectal cancer screening tests compared: FIT, stool DNA and blood
screening.description: See how FIT, stool DNA, the Shield blood test, CT colonography and colonoscopy compare in 1,000 people, with FIT thresholds and the trials behind them.

colonoscopy.title: Colonoscopy animated: bowel prep, polyp removal and quality measures
colonoscopy.description: Follow a colonoscopy from split-dose prep to snare polypectomy, and see why adenoma detection rate, withdrawal time and prompt follow-up after FIT matter.

schedule.title: Colorectal cancer screening ages and intervals: a guideline calculator
schedule.description: When to start screening, how often to repeat each test, and when the next colonoscopy is due after polyps, quoted from USPSTF, ACS, USMSTF and ESGE.

symptoms.title: Colorectal cancer symptoms: red flags, FIT test and path to diagnosis
symptoms.description: Bowel cancer warning signs with their published predictive values, how a FIT stool test triages symptoms, colonoscopy, staging scans and delays under 50.

staging.title: Colorectal cancer staging: TNM calculator and survival by stage
staging.description: Watch a bowel tumour grow through each T, N and M category, then work out its AJCC 8th edition stage, with SEER survival by stage and the IIB/IIIA paradox.

biomarkers.title: Colorectal cancer biomarkers: MMR/MSI, RAS, BRAF, HER2 and sidedness
biomarkers.description: An interactive decision tree shows which drugs each colorectal tumour test result opens or closes, plus an animation of universal MMR and Lynch testing.

surgery.title: Colorectal cancer surgery: colectomy, TME, lymph nodes and stomas
surgery.description: Animated colectomy by tumour site, total mesorectal excision and the circumferential margin, keyhole vs robotic trials, leaks and stomas.

chemo.title: Adjuvant chemotherapy for colon cancer: FOLFOX vs CAPOX, 3 or 6 months
chemo.description: FOLFOX and CAPOX cycles animated with the neuropathy they cause, IDEA trial results for 3 vs 6 months, and who benefits: stage II, dMMR, age.

rectal.title: Rectal cancer treatment: total neoadjuvant therapy and watch-and-wait
rectal.description: Rectal cancer month by month: MRI, short-course RT or chemoradiation, TNT, surgery or watch-and-wait, regrowth risk, and dostarlimab for dMMR.

metastatic.title: Metastatic colorectal cancer: spread, liver surgery, biomarker drugs
metastatic.description: How colorectal cancer spreads to liver and lungs, when metastases can be removed, and which drugs match MSI-H, RAS, BRAF, HER2 and KRAS G12C tumours.

cure.title: Colorectal cancer research: ctDNA, immunotherapy and evidence labels
cure.description: DYNAMIC and DYNAMIC-III animated: a ctDNA blood test that halves chemotherapy, plus NICHE-2, KRAS vaccines, exercise and aspirin, each with an evidence label.

living.title: Life after colorectal cancer: follow-up, LARS score, stoma, neuropathy
living.description: Five-year follow-up schedules and recurrence timing, a LARS bowel-function calculator, stoma care, oxaliplatin neuropathy and exercise evidence.

nursing.title: Colorectal cancer nursing: bowel prep, stoma, DPYD and chemo safety
nursing.description: Nursing pathway from bowel-prep teaching and stoma marking to ERAS, DPYD testing, chemotherapy toxicity checks and survivorship teaching.

history.title: History of colorectal cancer: timeline from Miles to immunotherapy
history.description: An animated timeline of bowel cancer from 1908 to 2026: Dukes staging, Lynch families, polypectomy, TME, the APC gene, screening trials and immunotherapy.

review.title: Colorectal cancer flashcards & mnemonics: 90 cards, 10 memory aids
review.description: 90 colorectal cancer flashcards and 10 mnemonics, from APC and MSI to FIT, TNM, IDEA and LARS, with an animated Amsterdam II 3-2-1-0 pedigree.

quiz.title: Colorectal cancer quiz: 98 questions with cited explanations
quiz.description: Test yourself on colorectal cancer: Lynch and FAP, FIT and colonoscopy quality, TNM staging, RAS and MSI, adjuvant chemo, rectal TNT and stoma care.

glossary.title: Colorectal cancer glossary: 172 terms explained with citations
glossary.description: Searchable colorectal cancer glossary from ADR, β-catenin and CIMP to TME, N1c, dMMR, watch-and-wait and LARS, linked to the module where each term matters.

sources.title: Colorectal Cancer Companion sources: every checked reference
sources.description: Every reference behind the Colorectal Cancer Companion, checked against PubMed, Europe PMC, Crossref, ClinicalTrials.gov or openFDA. Filter by area or search.
